principles: Never accept a witness through argv or an environment variable.
Write only to a newly created mode-0700 workspace.
Emit progress on a separate JSONL file descriptor; never include witness values, commitment interests, paths, RPC URLs, or filesystem paths in progress or telemetry.
Cross-user aggregation accepts proofs and public statements only, never witnesses.
Cancellation and crash recovery must leave no valid-looking partial proof.

commands.purpose: Validate public input and witness locally; create a private workspace and immutable job manifest.
Generate one proof atomically; write progress events separately from stdout/stderr.
Request bounded-latency cancellation; remove temporary proof bytes but preserve a resumable authenticated checkpoint when supported.
Authenticate and resume a checkpoint; reject parameter/input/build mismatches; prove that resumed public output verifies under the same statement.
Report only public proof metadata and hashes without opening a witness or contacting a network.
Create an offline upload package containing only proof and public statement material.

requirements: completedUnits never decreases within a phase
unknown totalUnits is null rather than fabricated
events are safe to disable without changing the proof transcript

checkpointContract.determinismMeaning: A resumed run restores the same authenticated prover state and produces a valid proof for the same public statement; byte-identical final proofs are required only if all prover randomness is retained and replayed by the checkpoint design.
forbidden: accepting a checkpoint from another statement or build

exitCodes.3: proof generation or local verification failed
exitCodes.6: privacy policy or unsafe workspace violation
